title: Inclusion criteria - clause 1
text: Participants must be aged 18-75 at the time of screening.

title: Inclusion criteria - clause 2
text: Documented diagnosis confirmed by central laboratory review.

title: Exclusion criteria - clause 3
text: Prior exposure to an investigational agent within 90 days.

title: Exclusion criteria - clause 4
text: Clinically significant renal impairment at screening.

title: Dosing - clause 5
text: Study drug is administered once daily in the morning with food.

title: Dosing - clause 6
text: Dose reduction to the next lower level is permitted once per participant.

title: Dosing - clause 7
text: Missed doses are not made up; the next scheduled dose is taken as planned.

title: Visit schedule - clause 8
text: Screening occurs within 28 days prior to first administration.

title: Visit schedule - clause 9
text: Safety follow-up occurs 30 days after the final administration.

title: Visit schedule - clause 10
text: Unscheduled visits are permitted and recorded as such.

title: Safety reporting - clause 11
text: Serious adverse events are reported within 24 hours of awareness.

title: Safety reporting - clause 12
text: Severity is graded using the protocol-specified grading scale.

title: Safety reporting - clause 13
text: Causality is assessed independently by the site investigator.

title: Laboratory - clause 14
text: Central laboratory processes all haematology and chemistry samples.

title: Laboratory - clause 15
text: Repeat testing is permitted for values flagged as implausible.

title: Randomisation - clause 16
text: Participants are randomised 2:1 to active or comparator.

title: Randomisation - clause 17
text: Stratification is by region and by baseline severity band.

title: Blinding - clause 18
text: The study is double-blind; unblinding requires medical monitor approval.

title: Blinding - clause 19
text: Emergency unblinding is available to sites at any hour.

title: Endpoints - clause 20
text: The primary endpoint is assessed at week 24.

title: Endpoints - clause 21
text: Key secondary endpoints are tested in a fixed hierarchical order.

title: Statistics - clause 22
text: The primary analysis uses the intent-to-treat population.

title: Statistics - clause 23
text: Missing data are handled by multiple imputation.

title: Supply - clause 24
text: Investigational product is shipped to sites in temperature-controlled units.

title: Supply - clause 25
text: Sites confirm receipt and temperature excursion status within 48 hours.

title: Supply - clause 26
text: Resupply is triggered automatically below a two-participant threshold.

title: Monitoring - clause 27
text: Risk-based monitoring visits occur at least every 12 weeks.

title: Monitoring - clause 28
text: Source data verification targets protocol-critical variables.

title: Consent - clause 29
text: Re-consent is required after any substantial protocol amendment.

title: Consent - clause 30
text: Consent documents are retained in the site investigator file.

title: Data management - clause 31
text: Queries are issued within five working days of data entry.

title: Data management - clause 32
text: Database lock follows resolution of all protocol-critical queries.

title: Withdrawal - clause 33
text: Participants may withdraw at any time without giving a reason.

title: Withdrawal - clause 34
text: Withdrawal from treatment does not require withdrawal from follow-up.

title: Pharmacovigilance - clause 35
text: The safety database is reconciled with the clinical database monthly.

title: Pharmacovigilance - clause 36
text: Expedited reports follow the applicable regional timelines.

title: Protocol deviations - clause 37
text: Deviations are categorised as major or minor at the time of entry.

title: Protocol deviations - clause 38
text: Major deviations are reviewed by the medical monitor.

title: Training - clause 39
text: Site staff complete protocol training before enrolling any participant.

title: Training - clause 40
text: Training records are retained for the duration of the study.
